SMALL CLAIMS CALENDAR OF NOV-28-2023 - TAKEN UNDER SUBMISSION AS OF NOV-28-2023 BY JUDGE PRO TEM PANG LY. PLAINTIFF YUANLONG MA IS PRESENT ASSISTED BY COURT CERTIFIED CANTONESE INTERPRETER DOROTHY WONG, CSR#300601. DEFENDANT ELIANA GRELLET BITENCOURT IS PRESENT. NO EXHIBITS RETAINED. JUDGE PRO TEM: PANG LY; CLERK: R. SAHATJIAN. NOT REPORTED. (D506)
DECLARATION RE: CHANGE OF ADDRESS FILED BY DEFENDANT BITENCOURT, ELIANA GRELLET
SMALL CLAIMS HEARING OF NOV-28-2023 - JUDGMENT.

THE COURT HAS ORDERED THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT ENTERED: IT IS ADJUDGED THAT PLAINTIFF MA, YUANLONG RECOVER FROM DEFENDANT BITENCOURT, ELIANA GRELLET $3,912.88 PRINCIPAL, $75.00 COSTS, TOTAL JUDGMENT $3,987.88, THE PHOTOGRAPHS SHORTLY TAKEN AFTER THE ACCIDENT SUPPORT FINDING THE DEFENDANT WAS OPERATING HER VEHICLE UNREASONABLY CLOSE TO THE PARKED CARS. IF SHE HAD MAINTAINED ADEQUATE DISTANCE, AND EVEN IF PLAINTIFF WAS ATTEMPTING TO MERGE ON TO THE TRAFFIC LANE, THERE WOULD HAVE BEEN SAFE DISTANCE TO AVOID THE ACCIDENT. STAY OF EXECUTION 30 DAYS NO EXHIBITS FILED
ACKNOWLEDGMENT OF SATISFACTION OF JUDGMENT, FULLY SATISFIED, AS TO DEFENDANT BITENCOURT, ELIANA GRELLET
